author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

I went back to LinkedIn to see if it had gotten any less unhinged over there, and it had not.

This time we've got a CEO who fired someone on their second day for leaving a work event without saying goodbye, a guy who schedules his partner for exactly 3.5 hours per day and calls it a system, a man who kicked his date out for not approving of his business playlist, and a Salesforce layoff that someone on LinkedIn described as a temporary retirement. LinkedIn is still a place that exists and people are still posting on it.

I did not log in for any of this. I have a doctor's note.
